reason: A DeepSeek Harness extension primarily designed to provide agent-assisted tutoring, including in-depth explanations, self-testing, learning-path planning, personal knowledge-base search, visualization, and study-note archiving.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 中的智能体提供深度讲解、自测题、学习路径规划、个人知识库检索、可视化学习内容和笔记归档能力。
summaries.en: Adds agent-facing tutoring tools to DeepSeek Harness for in-depth explanations, self-tests, learning-path planning, personal knowledge-base search, visual study content, and note archiving.

capabilities: Provides agent-facing tutoring workflows for explanations, quizzes, research, chat, and learning-path planning
Searches personal knowledge bases through retrieval-augmented search
Archives study notes and can write Markdown and self-contained HTML study pages to disk
Connects to local or remote DeepTutor services over HTTP/WebSocket, CLI, or SSH tunnels
